eps.ov: Taro Yamada gave up on baseball and enrolls in a high school with no baseball team. But that's where he finds the strongest battery, Haruka Kiyomine and Kei Kaname. Why would they be here? Besides, Kei has amnesia and forgot about baseball.
eps.oa: ترك «تارو يامادا» البيسبول والتحق بثانوية لا فريق بيسبول فيها. لكنه يجد هناك أقوى ثنائي رامٍ وملتقط: «هاروكا كيوميني» و«كي كانامي». فلماذا هما هنا؟ ثم إن كي فاقد للذاكرة وقد نسي البيسبول.

eps.ov: Kei still refuses to play baseball, but Haruka manages to lure him out to do batting practice with a certain offer. Aoi Todo and Shunpei Chihaya, who also gave up baseball like Taro did, can't hide their shock to witness their practice.
eps.oa: ما زال «كي» يرفض لعب البيسبول، لكن «هاروكا» ينجح في استدراجه إلى تدريب على الضرب بعرض بعينه. ولا يقدر «آوي تودو» و«شونبي تشيهايا»، اللذان تركا البيسبول كما فعل «تارو»، على إخفاء صدمتهما وهما يشهدان تدريبهما.

eps.ov: To get to know each other, Kei invites Todo and Chihaya to his house. In Kei's room, they find a glove that Haruka has hidden. While each of them faces what they can't let go, the practice game with Teitoku High begins.
eps.oa: ليتعارفوا يدعو «كي» «تودو» و«تشيهايا» إلى بيته. وفي غرفة كي يجدون قفازاً أخفاه «هاروكا». وبينما يواجه كل منهم ما لا يقدر على التخلي عنه، تبدأ المباراة الودية مع ثانوية «تيتوكو».

eps.ov: Against Teitoku's batters, Haruka pitches an immaculate inning, before Kotesashi's leadoff, Todo, hits a home run on the very first pitch he faces. As everyone holds their breath, the fated showdown between Haruka, Kei, and Kokuto begins!

After the game, Teitoku's manager suggests that Haruka, Kei, Todo, and Chihaya should transfer to Teitoku. Kei realizes they lost because of him and hopes to send the others off. Todo and Chihaya consider the offer, but what will their answers be?
As he learns more about the rules and tactics of baseball, Kei decides to set his sights on beating Teitoku in a revenge match. However, Todo is reminded why he quit baseball in the first place.

Todo volunteers to step down from shortstop due to his yips. But inspired by Kei's words, Todo decides to try practicing throwing to first. However, when his training hits a snag, Haruka says something that could ruin everything.

eps.t: Baseball in 3D Isn't Really My Thing...
eps.ov: Now that Todo has overcome his yips, the team are now working on improving Kei's skills. But the overwhelming demands make Kei escape to the rooftop, where he meets Tsuchiya Kazuki, an otaku who likes baseball video games, but hates real-life baseball.

eps.t: Who Do You Think You're Talking To?
eps.ov: Out of curiosity, the team attempts different methods to try and get Kei's memory to come back, but not a single one seems to work. However, the next day...

Kei's Commander mode comes to an end, and the despondent Kotesashi team allows Hikawa to take the lead. Kei tries to lift the mood of the team, but Chihaya seems to be struggling with a "wall" he has to overcome.

Top of the ninth inning, the hope of coming back from behind rests on Kei at bat. But the former Commander is overwhelmed by fast pitches by Makita. But words from Haruka reminds Kei of something important.
